facts.did: 尽可能快地乘 paddler 飞到考场楼，正好赶上看到 Oriel 与 Column 一起出来
facts.anchor: Gardenpath flew as fast as they could to the exam building

facts.did: 宣布“Column says I definitely passed!”，与 Gardenpath 用手臂相挽
说若非官方口径这算稳妥的推断，称赞答案“terrific”、数据整理得 impeccable，并说与农民的对谈会有实际影响
提议去旧 agronomy 田，那里的墙在几代前用于农业实验、仍覆满杂交花卉与藻类的杂乱多边形
facts.anchor: Let’s go to the old agronomy fields.

facts.did: 说又因伦理问题与 Column 争执，不再认为 Column 会继续做自己的秘密导师（secret adviser）
facts.anchor: I don’t think they’re going to be my secret adviser anymore

facts.did: 收到 Plumline 的消息，必须在 Clustersedge 期间去参加学习会（study session）
facts.anchor: I have to report to a study session during Clustersedge

facts.did: Oriel 伸臂去闻带刺红茎上的黄色簇状花，说“这些真奇怪”，Gardenpath 也嗅了花香并说喜欢
facts.anchor: yellow tufted blooms on spiny red stems

facts.did: 分手时相拥，手臂浅浅地置于彼此之内，感觉像对一桩无人承认的罪的宽恕
facts.anchor: They embraced, arms shallow inside each other

relations.relation: 最好的朋友（best friend）：Gardenpath 滚过去迎接刚考完的 Oriel
relations.anchor: rolling swiftly over to meet their best friend

relations.relation: Column 曾是 Gardenpath 的 adviser 兼朋友，一场分歧把二人拆开；Oriel 对此毫不知情
relations.anchor: driven their adviser and friend apart

relations.relation: 直属导师 Plumline 发来消息，命令 Gardenpath 在 Clustersedge 期间参加学习会
relations.anchor: I got a message from them saying I have to report

relations.relation: Column 认为 Oriel 应当尽早考 Third，但至少要等十次旅程之后
relations.anchor: Column thinks I should take it soon

relations.relation: Gardenpath 心头仍压着与 Murtis 之间所发生之事的情绪引力井
relations.anchor: what they had done with Murtis afterward

numbers.fact: Column 认为 Oriel 至少要过十次旅程之后才该考 Third

numbers.fact: Column 兴奋地伸长身体、挥动好几条手臂
numbers.anchor: elongating and gesturing excitedly with several arms
